info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Phosph Notebook Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Catalog Phosph Notebook Detail API enables users to enhance the product catalog with detailed information about phosph notebooks. This endpoint allows businesses to submit new notebook detail entries, including specifications and pricing information, vital for accurate representation in sales platforms. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems looking to streamline their product listings. By leveraging this API, businesses can ensure their catalog remains up-to-date with the latest offerings and features.

post.summary: Create new details for a phosph notebook.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create and add new details to an existing phosph notebook. It processes the provided information and stores it accordingly, enhancing the notebook's content and usability.

requestBody.description: This request body contains details for the phosph notebook operation. It allows you to provide necessary information required to create or modify notebook details.
